results.title: Interactive Films ‘The Run,’ ‘Kaiju Princess,’ ‘Back From the Other World’ Hit Taiwan Cinemas as Audiences Vote on Endings by Smartphone (EXCLUSIVE)
results.description: Taiwan audiences will vote on endings by smartphone as interactive films 'The Run' and 'Kaiju Princess' hit Showtime Cinemas from Nov. 27.

Quote Of The Day By Salim Khan On His 91st Birthday: ‘Jab Beta Aage Nikal Jata Hain, Tab...’
results.description: Veteran screenwriter and filmmaker Salim Khan is celebrating his 91st birthday on November 24. Best known for his iconic work as part of the legendary Salim-Javed duo, he has played a significant role in shaping Hindi cinema with films that continue to be remembered across generations. Beyond his contribution to the film industry, Salim Khan has also shared thoughtful insights.
